title: NDI source
description: Which sender on the network to receive from.

name.title: Sender name
name.description: The NDI name exactly as the sender announces it, usually MACHINE (SOURCE). The list_senders tool reports the ones this machine can see.

address.title: Address
address.description: host:port, for a sender mDNS cannot reach: another subnet, a VPN, or a network where multicast is filtered. Not needed when the name is enough.

bandwidth.title: Bandwidth
bandwidth.description: high is the full picture. low is a much smaller one at a fraction of the bandwidth, which is what a preview or a weak network wants. audio-only takes the sound and no picture.

timestamp_mode.title: Timestamps
timestamp_mode.description: Which clock the frames are stamped with. Leave it alone unless lip sync is wrong across several NDI sources, and then try timecode.
